mentions.name: Lean 4 formatter
mentions.description: A production-worthy code formatter for the Lean 4 programming language, configurable in the style of clang-format. It handles Lean's partial elaboration with backtracking and can already format important open source Lean libraries; mathlib4 remains the hardest case.
mentions.problem: Formatting mathlib4 has no viable plan yet, since it would likely require per-directory quirks files, which is probably a nonstarter.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Production-worthy formatter for lean4.

Right now it copes with important open source libraries on the model of clang-format's configuration, which is a real trick given the partial elaboration you need (with backtracking). But that works.

mathlib4 is the final boss, I don't currently even have a plan without per-directory quirks files which is probably a nonstarter.
mentions.author: reinitctxoffset
